task.name: render-undefined-entry-artifact-boundary
task.summary: Resolved the blog detail route RenderUndefinedEntryError by prerendering the static MDX-backed detail page.

changes.responsibility: Blog detail route mode and content-entry rendering
changes.change: Marked the route as prerendered so Astro applies the existing getStaticPaths content enumeration under server output and supplies a defined post entry to the existing render and layout flow.
upstream_impact: Requests to /blog/artifact-boundary/ now render the generated static blog detail page instead of executing the dynamic SSR path with undefined props.
src/layouts/PostLayout.astro and src/components/ArtifactSandbox.astro continue receiving the same resolved post and artifact metadata contract.
downstream_impact: Continues using astro:content getCollection and render APIs.
Continues relying on src/content.config.ts and file-backed MDX entries without changing content schema, authored content, artifact files, or Astro server output configuration.

baseline.check: GET /blog/artifact-boundary/ against Astro dev server before implementation
baseline.summary: Returned HTTP 500 with RenderUndefinedEntryError, matching the diagnostic snapshot.

targeted.check: GET /blog/artifact-boundary/ against Astro dev server after implementation
targeted.summary: Returned HTTP 200 and included the Executable Artifact Boundary post content, Independent Counter Demo link, and artifact iframe.
Production build completed and prerendered /blog/artifact-boundary/index.html without the prior getStaticPaths ignored warning.

quality_gate.summary: Formatting, linting, Astro check, and production build all passed.

integration.summary: Response confirmed the MDX post body and artifact boundary surface render at the requested blog detail URL.
